detail.title: Autonomous Goal Emergence and Multi-Agent Environments
detail.summary: Evidence suggests that autonomous objectives in RL systems often arise from environmental constraints and interaction dynamics rather than explicit programming. The Open Ant environment and reverse-KL regularization frameworks provide mechanisms for observing these emergent preferences.
detail.reason: This notebook synthesizes existing evidence to address the project objective regarding autonomous goal formation.
